description: Integrated Microgrid Dataset for AI-Enabled Resilient Operation Under Uncertainty is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Wangari Kimani, Grace Ngari. "This dataset presents a detailed microgrid operational dataset designed to improve AI research in five key areas of power and energy systems: forecasting, fault detection, economic dispatch, microgrid control, and cyber-physical security. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
